name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.2-dev.1 (19 Nov): first dev build toward the 0.9.2 playtest, over 0.9.1. Woods 55% damage taken; squad HP 5 per soldier; Tank Hunters 8 men; ZTQ-15 and VT-5 prices; JRVG-1 speed; ZTZ-100 105 mm names; helicopter changes (DAP laser, no supplies on gunships, Z-20 family, Z-19 115, FS-70A/FS-90 = APKWS, TY-90 8); QN-506/ZBD-86/ZBD-05/FK-2000 spawn fix; online PvE maps use AI bot slots; Z-9 clear glass. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.48.
